newsitem.title: USA: Lifetime Hoan sees lower Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Lifetime Hoan sees lower Q1 results.

text.p: Lifetime Hoan Corp said Wednesday it anticipated net income for its first quarter ending March 31 to be about $1.3 million as compared to $1.7 million in the previous year's quarter.

The company noted that the projected decrease would be due to seasonal operating losses from the its Farberware retail outlet stores acquired in April 1996, and not included in the comparable prior year's quarter.

Lifetime's chairman, president and chief executive Milton Cohen said in a statement, "Historically, the stores have been profitable only in the fourth quarter. We are currently exploring opportunities to address this, as well as to increase overall store profitability."
Lifetime Hoan designs, markets and distributes household cutlery, kitchenware and cutting boards.
